subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should transcript-bound managed-image bytes returned by `artifacts.download` permanently use the existing `operator.read` artifact scope, or require `operator.admin`?
rationale: Current artifact and workspace-read APIs use the trusted `operator.read` domain, but this PR newly permits a read-scoped RPC to return Gateway-local managed-media bytes that direct HTTP intentionally restricts to owner context; repository policy requires the Gateway owner to confirm that boundary.

options.title: Keep operator.read
options.body: Accept the existing artifact scope after all session, record, transcript, URL, and coordinate bindings pass, then require exact-head allowed/denied live proof before merge.

options.title: Require operator.admin
options.body: Raise managed-byte downloads to admin and update protocol wording, Control UI recovery behavior, and focused authorization tests together.

options.title: Pause the RPC path
options.body: Keep the PR open without landing until a narrower authorization contract or alternate preview mechanism is designed.

recommendation.title: Keep operator.read
recommendation.body: Accept the existing artifact scope after all session, record, transcript, URL, and coordinate bindings pass, then require exact-head allowed/denied live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR already routes the permanent Gateway authorization question to this recent managed-image HTTP contributor.
